text: Not everything that is faced can be changed, but nothing can be changed until it’s faced.
It takes time to become someone you haven’t been before.
There is no motion without stillness.
We do not see things as they are. We see things as we are.

In a world full of people that desperately seek connection, we’re oddly good at avoiding connection at all costs when offered. One needs to connect with themselves first before they can connect with someone else.
Success is getting what you fucking want. Fulfillment is bringing what you’re made for to those you love and those you’ve learned to love.
Words to get out of any kind of a funky place - “Count your blessings.”
I’m convinced that the epitome of human expression is LOVE, in all of its forms – for it is the only expression that transcends reason, time, mortality and even existence.
You never quit because of pain being unbearable in the moment. You quit because of the perception of pain down the road.
When you have a desire for something, the fulfillment of the desire already exists causing you to desire it. You will never want something that you are not meant, at some point, to receive.
The ability to observe without evaluating is the highest form of intelligence.
You’re not a brief arrangement of the atoms experiencing the universe. You’re the universe briefly arranged into a form that can experience itself.
What are you truly afraid of when nothing in the world belongs to you?
A weak character will neutralize all of the other possible good qualities a person might possess.
Judging people by their actions and not taking them personally will free you up, help you keep your emotional balance.
Absolute power corrupts absolutely.
Having power may corrupt, but having absolutely no power corrupts absolutely.
Learn to tell the lions from the lambs or pay the price.

Be convinced, there are no persons so insignificant and inconsiderable, but may, some time or other, have it in their power to be of use to you; which they will not, if you have once shown them contempt.
People will tend to judge you on your outward appearance. Never settle on one image or give people the power to completely figure you out. Create some mystery around you.
The people are always impressed by the superficial appearance of things.
The true spirit of conversation consists more in bringing out the cleverness of others than in showing a great deal of it yourself.
No one is so brave that he is not disturbed by something unexpected.
Do not give the dogs what is holy and do not throw your pearls before swine, lest they trample them underfoot and turn to attack you.
What people lack in life is not more reality but illusion, fantasy, play.
Practice even what seems impossible.
The only way to get rid of temptation is to yield to it.
Most men are so thoroughly subjective that nothing really interests them but themselves.
Never argue. In society nothing must be discussed; give only results.
To multiply small successes is precisely to build one treasure after another. In time one becomes rich without realizing how it has come about.
So to win a hundred victories in a hundred battles is not the highest excellence; the highest excellence is to subdue the enemy's army without fighting at all.
The greatest danger occurs at the moment of victory.
The primary law of human nature is to deny that we have human nature, to deny that we are subject to these forces.
The greatest discovery of my generation is the fact that human beings can alter their lives by altering their attitudes of mind.
Examine the faults you see in others and how they are in you as well.
Develop the habit of examining in depth your own emotional responses. You will end up slowly eliminating unnecessary reactions.
Time is the only currency you spend without knowing your balance.
The quality of your life is directly proportional to your tolerance for uncertainty.
